objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction, or other document handled from creation through release, distribution, revision, archiving, translation, and reactivation.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Title included in the document name.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Document type abbreviation included in the document name.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Cross-client consecutive number per document type included in the document name.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Workflow or lifecycle status of the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released document is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date calculated from valid from and the period of extended validity.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed into a template-based document.

attributes.name: reference
attributes.description: Document property used to link documents to master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_application
attributes.description: Document property used to link documents to IT applications.

attributes.name: relevant_company
attributes.description: Document property for companies relevant to the document.

attributes.name: area_of_validity
attributes.description: Document property for the document's area of validity.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Classification selected when creating a document, such as policy, guideline, procedural instruction, or work instruction.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation used in document naming.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period after which validity must be checked for documents of the type.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period after which archived documents of the type are physically deleted.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selectable when creating a document.

objs.name: file
objs.description: External file or MS Office document uploaded or generated as document content.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person participating as creator, author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator, reader, initiator, or business admin in document processes.

attributes.name: system_role
attributes.description: Implemented role such as reader, author, reviewer, releaser, or translator.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group used to assign readers, authors, reviewers, releasers, archive access, business admin permissions, or distribution recipients.

objs.name: authorization
objs.description: Read or write right assigned to user groups or persons for documents and dependent objects.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants in release, validity extension, override, reactivation, or acknowledgement workflows.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature completed by workflow participants and documented for each released version.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document and without its own release cycle.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attached to a main document, released with the main document and subject to versioning.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal created for a document to request a change without directly affecting the document content or version history.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Processing status of the change proposal.

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document before validity expires and processed with workflow support.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: Request created to invalidate and archive a released document that has no additional validity.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: Request created to reactivate an invalidated document.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of user groups or persons maintained for a document for e-mail distribution or acknowledgement.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation by a recipient that acknowledgement of a released document has been completed.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which document visibility can be specified.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Process to which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational unit to which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Risk to which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Master data to which documents can be automatically linked.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in the system by attaching a new information object and selecting its type.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: Select a template for a new document.

evts.name: upload_file
evts.description: Upload an external file or document to a document cover.

evts.name: generate_file
evts.description: Generate a new document based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: maintain_document_properties
evts.description: Maintain standardized or customer-specific metadata in document properties.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Edit document content using the editing client and local Office component.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Save the edited document.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert the saved document to PDF.

evts.name: create_version
evts.description: Automatically create a new editing version when a released document is changed or revised.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign group-related or person-related authorizations for a document.

evts.name: assign_workflow_participant
evts.description: Assign author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, or translation participants in document properties.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Add additional information to a document.

evts.name: release_additional_info
evts.description: Release and publish additional information directly via properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Delete additional information directly.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Add a controlled attachment to a document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Change an existing attachment.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark or archive an attachment with the document process.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: Start the three-step Creator, Review, Release workflow for a document.

evts.name: sign_creation
evts.description: Registered author signs the creation workflow step.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Assigned reviewers check the document.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Assigned releaser completes the release step and releases the document.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A participant rejects during review or release, cancelling the workflow for subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish a released document so it is visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: Inform involved users about workflow tasks, releases, validity extension, change proposals, distribution, or acknowledgements by e-mail.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a change proposal for a released or validated document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a change proposal for implementation, creating a new document version.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Document the editing of an assigned change proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Complete a change proposal so it is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: Create a request for validity extension 30 days before document validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity and update the document valid-until date.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Revise a document when validity checking determines it needs updating.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Create a request to invalidate a selected document.

evts.name: invalidate_document
evts.description: Declare a document out of force, archive it, delete edited versions, and revoke rights except archive group access.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Physically delete archived documents after the archive period expires.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation and select the corresponding document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Confirm reactivation, create a new document version, restore authorizations, and reactivate archived attachments.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Assign user groups or persons for document distribution.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Inform assigned users and user groups by e-mail when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Request assigned recipients to confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient confirms acknowledgement of the current document version.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released document content into another language.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Check and release a translated document version with workflow support.

evts.name: set_client_visibility
evts.description: Specify in which clients a document is visible.

evts.name: create_document_reference
evts.description: Create a reference from a local document to the original document.

o2o.description: A document has a selected document type.
One or more templates can be defined for each document type.
A document can be created from a selected template.
A document cover can have external files uploaded or generated files attached as content.
A document has users assigned as author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator, reader, creator, or initiator.
A document has user groups assigned for readers, author selections, reviewer selections, releaser selections, archive access, or distribution.
Authorizations are assigned for each document.
Person-related authorizations grant read or write rights to users.
Group-related authorizations grant read or write rights to user groups.
Additional information can be attached to a document.
Attachments are associated with a main document.
A change proposal clearly belongs to a document and is displayed in it.
A validity extension request is linked to the document to be checked.
An override request is created for a selected document.
A reactivation request selects the corresponding document for reactivation.
A distribution list can be maintained for each document.
Persons can be assigned directly to a distribution list.
User groups can be assigned to a distribution list.
An acknowledgement confirms receipt of a current document version.
A user confirms an acknowledgement.
Workflow tasks are assigned to workflow participants.
A signature is completed by an individual workflow participant.
Signatures are documented for each released document version.
A document can be visible or not visible in specified clients.
Documents can be linked with processes.
Documents can be linked with organizational units.
Documents can be linked with risks.
Documents can be linked with master data.
Documents can reference other documents, including local documents referencing original documents.

o2e.description: The event creates a document.
A document type is selected during document creation.
A user creates the document.
The event selects a template for the document.
The selected template is used for the document.
The uploaded file is added to the document cover.
The event uploads an external file or document.
A user uploads the file.
The generated file becomes document content.
The event generates a file based on an MS Office format.
A user generates the file.
The event maintains the document's properties and metadata.
A user maintains document properties.
The event edits the document content.
A user edits document content.
The document is saved.
A user saves the document.
The saved document is converted to PDF.
A new editing version of the document is created.
Authorizations are assigned for the document.
The event assigns read or write rights.
Person-related authorization can be assigned to a user.
Group-related authorization can be assigned to a user group.
Users are assigned as workflow participants.
Workflow participants are assigned in document properties.
Additional information is added to the document.
The event creates or attaches additional information.
The author decides which information object is added.
The event releases and publishes additional information.
A user releases additional information via properties.
The event deletes additional information.
A user deletes additional information.
A controlled attachment is added to the main document.
The event creates or attaches an attachment.
The author decides to add an attachment.
Modifying an attachment affects the associated document version.
The event changes the attachment.
A user modifies the attachment.
Archiving an attachment affects the associated document version.
The event archives or marks the attachment for archiving.
A user archives the attachment.
The release workflow is started for the document.
The author or a co-author starts the workflow.
Workflow tasks are created for the release workflow.
The creation step is signed for the document.
The registered author signs the creation step.
The creation workflow task is completed.
The event records an electronic signature.
The document is reviewed.
Assigned reviewers check the document.
Review workflow tasks are completed.
Review participants complete tasks with electronic signatures.
The document is released.
An assigned releaser releases the document.
The release workflow task is completed.
The releaser completes the task with an electronic signature.
Attachments are automatically released with the main document.
The document workflow is rejected.
A reviewer or releaser rejects the task.
Subsequent workflow tasks are cancelled after rejection.
The released document is published.
Users involved receive e-mail notifications.
E-mail notifications inform users about task status and existence.
Notifications can concern document release, validity extension, distribution, or acknowledgement.
Notifications are sent when change proposals are created or edited.
A change proposal is created for the document.
The event creates the change proposal.
An employee with author rights creates the change proposal.
Scheduling a change proposal creates a new document version.
The event schedules the change proposal for implementation.
A user schedules the change proposal.
The event documents editing of the assigned change proposal.
The document author edits the assigned change proposal.
The event completes the change proposal.
A user completes the change proposal.
The request is linked to the document whose validity is expiring.
The system creates the validity extension request.
The document remains valid and its valid-until date is updated.
The validity extension request is deleted after additional validity is declared.
Releasers or release-process users check and extend validity.
Validity extension is processed with workflow support.
Attachments to the document are also released and have the same validity.
The document is revised and updated in a new version.
The author creates the new version and updates the document.
The pending validity extension process is terminated and the request is deleted after release of the revised version.
The override request is created for a selected document.
The event creates the override request.
A user with write access creates the override request.
The workflow for processing the override request starts automatically.
The document is declared out of force and archived.
Attachments are invalidated and archived with the document.
The override request is retained for documentation.
Rights are revoked except archive group access.
The archive group retains read access.
Override workflow steps are processed by releaser or initiator, reviewer, and releaser.
The archived document is physically deleted after the archive period.
The archive duration is defined for the document type.
The document is selected for reactivation.
The event creates the reactivation request.
Only the business admin group is permitted to create reactivation requests.
The workflow is started automatically after request creation.
The invalidated document is reactivated and a new version is created.
The reactivation request is confirmed.
The request creator is the editor of the workflow step.
Attachments archived with the document are reactivated.
Authorizations are set according to maintained attributes.
User groups and persons on the distribution list are confirmed from the invalidated version.
Distribution is maintained for the document.
The distribution list is maintained.
Persons can be assigned to the distribution list.
User groups can be assigned to the distribution list.
Assigned users and groups automatically receive read authorization.
A new released document version is distributed by e-mail.
Assigned users and groups are used for e-mail distribution.
Users receive e-mail notification.
Users in assigned user groups receive e-mail notification.
Acknowledgement is requested for the released document.
The maintained acknowledgement distribution list determines recipients.
Recipients are requested by e-mail to confirm acknowledgement.
Users of assigned user groups are requested to confirm acknowledgement.
Acknowledgement is workflow-supported without a signature.
The acknowledgement concerns the current document version.
The acknowledgement is confirmed.
The recipient confirms acknowledgement.
The acknowledgement workflow task is completed.
Released document content is translated.
A translator translates released content.
The translated document version is checked and released.
Translation reviewers and releasers participate in the workflow.
The translation approval process is workflow-supported.
The event specifies visibility in clients.
The event sets where the document is visible.
A local document can reference an original document.
A user creates the reference.
